topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: Oh my gosh, have you seen this? Someone actually got my art tattooed! I can't even tell you how amazed I am. I mean, it's one thing to like a piece, but to want it permanently on your skin? That's a whole new level of commitment, and it’s just so... wow. I feel like I’m on cloud nine. This is the kind of thing that makes all the late nights and early mornings worth it. I’m just so thankful for the support and the love for my work. It really does mean the world to me.
